rows.text: ...Seafeld City has been severely affected by the incident. Citizens are advised to remain patient and await assistance...
rows.speaker: News Broadcast

rows.text: Moving on to our special segment: The Phantasmoon Brief.
rows.speaker: News Broadcast

rows.text: I'm happy you made it back safely. But somehow, you just don't seem quite the same...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh, right, tell me about what happened at the TV Tower! I've heard Dan Heng and Sunday's side of the story, but I haven't heard yours yet.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: And then you mentioned that Nescia, the one we met at Star Rail FEST, is actually the Phantasmoon Games' arbitrator? No wonder she could draw a mask for you!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes, Graphia. Himeko's ancestor. She's an artist from a thousand years ago.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (So many things to deal with right now. What should I do next?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Nah, I've had a long day. I should just get some rest.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: From our very first steps, trouble has always followed the Nameless.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I promised someone that when the moon over my hometown was full again, I would go back to see her, to let her know I had made the most of this borrowed life, and found companions I could trust with all my heart.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'd also like to invite you all to the place where I repaired the Express, and tell you everything bit by bit.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Good question. As for who in Planarcadia knows Graphia and the World in Canvas best, it's probably Pearl. She was sent here by the IPC.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm not sure if she comes with good news or bad news. She brought a little gift from the Xianzhou though... Mung Bean Soda...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: What I am about to tell you is something Evanescia risked breaking the rules to share with me. Please keep it a secret. Not a word of this leaves the Express.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Rumor has it THEY were last seen during the era of the Swarm Disaster. THEY were hardly there to aid the Swarm, but rather to attend a cosmic-level feast, in which the Swarm served merely as appetizers and the planets THEY passed were devoured as the main course.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: The true situation remains unknown. But with this information, we can understand why Asat Pramad set his sights on this world.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Fortune follows when fate hits its lowest ebb. Every crisis comes with an opportunity.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: What "miracle" could cap off these games better than a finale that humbles a Lord Ravager? It will be a tribute to the Elation!
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Before I set out, I still want to say a few words to everyone.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What are they all up to over there?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Oh, there you are, [Trailblazer]. We were waiting for you!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What are you all doing here?
We're here to celebrate the Astral Express making it through another trial, of course! Pom-Pom's heard all about your latest adventure!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: It's a modest celebration, but a meaningful one. You stopped Fulwish's scheme, and that is no small achievement. Regardless of what the people of Planarcadia or the media may say, we raise a glass to you.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Exactly! You knocked out the mastermind behind all those creepy Joy... whatever their name is. I didn't get to see it myself, but Dan Heng described it for me. You killed it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Your victory gave Blade a chance to free himself from Shuhu's flesh. Thank you, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: With a Lord Ravager looming on the horizon, everyone will soon be heading off on their own missions. Before that, it felt right to have a small gathering like this.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Now, let's make a toast.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Here's to everyone who fights to protect this arcadia.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: And here's to all of us. The Lord Ravager can throw whatever he wants at us, but I know the Astral Express will keep streaking across the stars.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Thank you, all of you. Having you by my side is what gives me the courage to face the future. I'll carry this strength with me through the rest of this journey.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Cheers!
rows.speaker: Crowd

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I heard from Sunday about how the "televised debate" went.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: We won this battle because of you.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Mr. Yang, was everything okay on the Express?
How was the situation in Duomension City?
The streets were in chaos, traffic ground to a halt, and wispae littered the ground. It was like a scene straight out of a disaster movie.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: When the "Televised Debate" began, a crowd outside the station gathered to protest the Astral Express and nearly broke through the barricades. But the moment the Joy Ascendants appeared, they scattered without a second thought.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I guess people know deep down which is more dangerous: a made-up villain or an actual threat.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: But I am more concerned about you, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Me?
I'm feeling okay. Why?
I've seen the footage of your fight with Fulwish. When you returned to the top of the tower, an enormous surge of power seemed to erupt from you.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It reminded me a lot of when I saved you at Herta Space Station. Did you tap into the power of the Stellaron?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Maybe.
I don't know...
From what I can see, you're in pretty good shape right now.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: The Stellaron can be awakened by a wish, but its immense power always has a way of warping reality.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: As the wave of Wishpower surged toward you, it brought hope and blessings, but also dark intentions and malice. What might it do to the Stellaron? We have no idea.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Be careful with this power you have, no matter how tempting it may seem.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: [Trailblazer], did you need something?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Why are you here alone?
The others are having a lot of fun. Why don't you join them?
I need a break. I've felt worn out ever since coming back from Seafeld TV Tower.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Right now, it feels like I'm back in Oak Manor's banquet hall. At those parties, no matter how tired I was, I'd have to clutch my glass and smile, keeping myself calm.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Mr. Yang insisted I should get a full day of sleep, but I didn't want to miss the chance to toast with you all.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Thank you for being with me on this journey.
I should thank you for letting me embark on this journey.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Oh, it's you, [Trailblazer]! Pom-Pom heard you've got a solo mission coming up. Be safe, will you?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Conductor, do you remember anything from before the Express got back up and running?
How did you and Himeko meet, Pom-Pom?
Pom-Pom, have you heard of the name Graphia?
Conductor, it's time for me to say goodbye.
Sadly, Pom-Pom can't remember most of what happened right after the Express crashed onto this world!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Pom-Pom's memory of those years is like a fogged-up Express window. No matter how hard Pom-Pom tries, Pom-Pom just can't wipe it clean!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: But it's okay! After Passenger Himeko repaired the Express, Pom-Pom got to share a one-of-a-kind journey with all of you!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: How did Passenger Himeko appear? That's odd... Pom-Pom can't remember a thing. All Pom-Pom recalls is having a long and fuzzy sleep, then being woken by a knock at the door. And just like that, Passenger Himeko was on board.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The day Passenger Himeko knocked, it felt like Pom-Pom was waking up from a dream. The Express's heart started beating again, and the lights flickered on, one after another.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Graphia? Pom-Pom hasn't.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: But Pom-Pom always dreams of strangers when Pom-Pom's asleep. They seem to be bustling around the Express, and there are soft clinking and clanking sounds, just like... like the sound of stars twinkling.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: But every time Pom-Pom wakes up, their faces slip away. Pom-Pom is only left with a warm and comforting feeling, knowing someone had taken good care of Pom-Pom.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Safe trip! Pom-Pom will take good care of the Express while you're away!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: There you are. March and I were talking about you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You two missed me?
Worried about me?
What about?
Ever since coming to Planarcadia, nothing surprises me anymore.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Since when did you get so understanding?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If you're all grown-up and serious, we just can't click like we used to anymore!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I am so cute and lovely! What's the problem with that!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yeah, of course.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: When did Dan Heng start expressing his feelings like this? I guess pigs really do fly!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who is that?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Graphia?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: A little. But March is obviously worrying too much.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I wish I were as calm as you. I'm gonna go take a minute and collect myself.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I shouldn't have asked so many questions. Didn't mean to stress you out or make you worried... I'm gonna go take a minute and collect myself.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I shouldn't have asked so many questions. Didn't mean to stress you out or make you worried... I'm gonna go take a minute and collect myself.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, what's that supposed to mean? I... I have a reasonable amount of concern for my companions!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You, me, and March. The three of us.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Exactly! The power trio of this Express!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's a long story filled with many memories of my past.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Because it's a long story filled with many memories of my past.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This trip to Planarcadia is the first time we weren't necessarily working together toward a common goal.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's the first of many mysteries... Based on our family history, we are clearly not descendants of any long-lived species.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: There are far too many legends about her. It's hard to tell what's true and what's not.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Nobody knows just how big the plane Graphia created actually is. Over 140 years ago, the IPC tried to salvage the World in Canvas, but they were only able to reconstruct part of it in the real world. That portion became what we know as Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You dove into the Phantasmoon Games. I... crossed paths with that relentless old friend-and-foe again. As for March... Well, she spent her time wandering and eating. Her perfect little vacation...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Wait, wait, hold up! How come all I get is "wandering and eating"? I grabbed plenty of comics as well!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I call it cultural exploration, with a little extra time for me to recharge, of course! Right, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You mean the leviathan that can swallow whole planets... That Oroboros the Voracity?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Wait, you've never heard of the Voracity before?
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Now that we're having this little break, it hit me that I might have neglected you and March.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You're overthinking it!
That's impressive, īśvara. No wonder you survived the calamity of Irontomb.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Interesting. You wouldn't flinch even if a star fell upon you. A true īśvara.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: To us, this is just Trailblazing!

A funeral, or an adventure? Will it be a battle with only a one-in-ten chance of survival to tear away Shuhu's flesh from his body and eliminate the Xianzhou's Archenemy? Or will it be a journey in which he settles all grudges and never looks back? It all depends on how he perceives it.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Betting? No, I don't see it that way.
rows.speaker: Yao Guang

rows.text: Dan Heng, we are peers!
Yeah, we are actually more concerned about your condition, Dan Heng!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well said. This vacation has expanded my horizons and my stomach capacity!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This is an important matter. Furthermore, your journey gives her the chance to uncover something she's been yearning to understand for years: the secret to Graphia's art of imagenesis.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Actually, I hoped you could take some time to rest first.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Why are you suddenly acting like the adult here!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I am indeed quite curious. I'd love to see this ancestor of mine for myself and hear her story in her own words.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Please tell her that one of her descendants became a Nameless on the Express.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Blade has accepted General Yao Guang's proposal. Perhaps he has finally moved on from past grudges and that Abundance curse, and is now ready to do something for himself.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's going to be a path fraught with danger, so I had hoped to accompany him for a bit longer, but he refused.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: From now on, I will turn my attention to this world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What are you going to do next?
Mr. Yang and I have been asked by General Yao Guang to help with setting up some defensive formations.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I've got work to do too. Mr. Ashveil wanted someone to accompany him to the tavern to investigate clues about Asat Pramad. Yours truly figured she'd been resting long enough, and it was time to stretch her legs, so I volunteered.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Can't believe we're splitting up again...
Stay safe. Don't make me worry too much.
No problem! When you come back, you have to share everything you saw in the World in Canvas!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Once you've fully rested, you may make your way to the dock in Seafeld City.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Thank you, everyone!
Go ahead. Set out once you've rested up. I'll be here with Welt and the others, awaiting good news from you.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Glasses clink together, like your hearts beating as one.
After finishing the drinks, the Nameless each enjoy a brief moment of respite.
In other words, that woman wants you to take Shuhu and jump straight into the Voracity, and leave the rest to the Aeon's stomach acid?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: And... this is between me and him, right?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Why are you tagging along?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Relax. I'll say my goodbyes and be gone.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "A dignified funeral," huh... If you ask me, this ending is indeed grand enough.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I don't care about any of that.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: There's only one thing I care about. Does he have to die?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Here's a piece of advice, little cub.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Whether he lives or dies is his choice. That's the one thing you don't get to decide for him.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ...It has landed.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: What?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Nothing. Just a seabird, landing on the rocks.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: A blade forged of mortal steel cannot sever an undying fate.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: If Shuhu is to be put down, the options are few, and that leviathan is one of them.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: In time, people will say this: The culprit of the Zhuming gave his life for the greater good and plunged into the abyss alongside the abomination.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I'm not as noble as you make it sound.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Many years ago, you invited me to join the Galaxy Rangers. I refused for one reason...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I'm a petty man. I was never born to carry some greater good.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: This is between Shuhu and me. Nothing more.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Hah... Can't argue with that. A Galaxy Ranger through and through.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Well then, I won't say anything more.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Blade... you sure about this?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: For years, death has clung to me like a curse etched into my bones.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: If there is a chance to make a god feel the same pain, I would do it, even if this body is reduced to ash.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: As for everyone else, there's no need to drag them into this.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: We'll proceed as Yao Guang proposed. Bury Shuhu at the end of the World in Canvas, taking me with him, and let the Voracity dissolve us both.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...Take care.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: How about you stay as well? You might as well see it through to the end with us.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Planarcadia has bigger problems that need my attention.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Your instincts were right. That "meanie" pulling strings from the shadows is none other than Asat Pramad.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Who else would want to kick Aha's head like a ball?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: So, I need to get back and finish my job.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Investigating a Lord Ravager sounds like a job you don't come back from.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Therefore it also pays very well.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Then here's hoping you live long enough to collect your payment.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Tch. Every time. When it's just the two of us, you go quiet.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: You know what I'm going to say.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...The seabird's flown off.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: It's time for us to go too.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: And so, the people set out, and the gondola bound for distant lands set sail.
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: At the end of the world, the Elation once again declared war upon the Voracity...
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: "Ke-ke-ke! Frail little humans!" Oroboros split THEIR mouth wide open!
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: "Whoever can fill my whole mouth with but a single thing shall receive a reward: my tongue!"
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: The Fool known as the Shepherd captured a comet, but it wasn't even enough to fill the gap between the Voracity's teeth.
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: The bartender Bragi opened the wine cellar, yet THEY only grew drowsy, drifting off to sleep.
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: And Enroute? He crept up to the Voracity's ear and told THEM a corny joke. The Voracity pondered it for ten Amber Eras, then burst into laughter at THEIR own amusement!
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: Enroute spread his hands and said: "See? I filled your mouth with laughter."
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: An old pal who can't stop lying. He goes on and on about death being a solitary feast. But I just saw him last week, alive.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Bragi? Forget it. He's good behind the bar, but slippery as an eel. Ask him to work for Nanook and he'd run away on the spot.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: That's just a title. Anyone with a girlish heart can call themselves "Dorothy."
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Him? He caused trouble in Gothum City a few days ago. Pearl threw him into prison.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Uh... Then what happened?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Then? Then the Voracity said:
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: "Are you kidding me!?" And with that, THEY opened THEIR gaping maw and tore Enroute to pieces!
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: What kind of nonsense is that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Those are the facts, my inquisitive auditor.
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: If you want to hear more stories, you're welcome to discuss with your classmates!
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: We came here to investigate the Voracity and Asat Pramad, but all we got were stories that only a three-year-old would believe!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Rumors don't just appear out of thin air. It's just a matter of how much truth you think they hold.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: At least ninety percent of that was made up.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sometimes, that last ten percent is all you need.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You two! You didn't shout, didn't clown around, and you didn't even stuff notes into anyone else's mouth.
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: Such diligent Fools are a rare sight indeed.
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: Oh, you're not Fools at all? That makes sense, that makes a lot of sense.
rows.speaker: "Golden Teacher"

rows.text: Plenty of bystanders around. Let's hear what they have to say.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Then, poof! THEY were gone! Even Cosmicon Collective don't got a Voracity card!
rows.speaker: Dewide Chungus

rows.text: I already— filed a formal complaint— with the organizers! *Burp*!
rows.speaker: Dewide Chungus

rows.text: Heeey, friends! How was your first day of school?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Sparxie's here to pick you up after class!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Where were you just now? You opened the door for us and just disappeared. Don't tell me you're up to something again.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Still doubting me? You're breaking Sparxicle's heart here!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: That whole Fulwish thing? I took on every emoti in the tavern by myself, fought them all the way to the end of the world, and even wore my mask down to nothing!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: But honestly, this place runs on rumors. Aha is being chased by the Voracity, Aha chases the Voracity... We won't get anywhere following stories like this.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Let's go through what we know so far...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Yeah, it's a complete mess.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: So, after a bit of thought, Lady Sparxie came up with a brilliant idea: I borrowed a nifty little gadget from a friend...
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: The Unreal Sparxin' Spark! No idea how it works, but apparently this lightbulb makes you smarter the moment you put it on.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Does this friend know you "borrowed" it?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Asat Pramad has a gun to our heads, and this is what you're worried about? He'll find out one day.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Well then, I'll go first?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It doesn't look very reliable. Are you sure about this?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: No worries! If anything goes wrong, {RUBY_B#Evernight}the friend in my head{RUBY_E#} will protect me.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Doesn't seem to have any effect.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: No, it's working perfectly. I get it now, all of it, no need to dance around.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Our enemy is a Lord Ravager. There's only one question we need answered: How does Asat Pramad plan to destroy Elation?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Correction: The effect is very obvious.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Judging by Nanook's habit of picking Lord Ravagers, I wouldn't be surprised if Asat Pramad was once a Masked Fool and therefore knows Aha's weakness.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The arcadia is like a microcosm of Aeons and paths. People indulge themselves in fabricated happiness, unable to pull themselves away from it. Many have expressed their concerns: "This isn't Elation. Aha is playing with fire."
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: A classic social-realist deduction, old-fashioned, but effective. We're closing in on the truth.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Yes. The answer is all but revealed...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You are Asat Pramad, "Sparxie"!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Do you have evidence?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Of course. The truth is so simple that everyone overlooked it. The evidence is...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You were the first person I met when I got off the Express.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If I am Asat Pramad, would you and Gray Hair have been able to walk out of the school alive?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Yeah. Fair point.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Just take that thing off already!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: That's weird. I thought I was on the right track...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let me give you a lesson: Deduction isn't about people skills. It's about smart tricks and flawless logic.
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Watch and learn. Sparkle, master of the classic whodunit, has entered the chat!
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: You changed your clothes just for this?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: First of all, Oroboros likes to eat. Secondly, whatever THEY eat disappears completely.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: Therefore, Voracity is also a form of Destruction.
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: This is the classic mystery of one culprit, two identities! The one trying to kill Elation is...
rows.speaker: Sparkle

rows.text: The Lord Ravager Asat Pramad, played by the Voracity!
