rows.text: Gray-haired {M#boy,}{F#girl,} you seek me out with {RUBY_B#Evanescia}her{RUBY_E#} token in hand. What is it that you desire?
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: Me, of course.
Not you again... A meanie will always be a meanie.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Misfortune and I share one thing in common: we both enjoy dropping in uninvited.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: A reunion after a thousand years. Graphia, it has been a long time.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Asat Pramad...
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: Back at Inkford Hermitage, what you heard was only half the story.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: A thousand years ago, amidst the ruins of Ahatopia, I found a baby girl on the verge of death.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Her cold, lifeless body reminded me of the legend of "Elation." Aha heard an infant cry and burst into laughter.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Too bad I never did get the joke. So, I came up with a much better one.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Graphia's archnemesis...

I infused that child with the power of "Destruction," giving her the rebirth of a Voidranger. I taught her to paint her monstrous beasts using the life of the Voracity as pigment, all to carry out the Legion's divine will.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Graphia, your name was your commission. To paint the world and "carve a trace of our lasting glory, just before the world meets its destruction."
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: You were doing so well. Right up until you saw that Express crash. It gave you ideas, Graphia. Unrealistic, foolish ideas.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Since that day, I have had nothing to do with you or your "Destruction."
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: Your failure began the moment you tried to destroy the Express. All you did was turn the spirit of the Nameless into a rallying cry for rebellion.
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: I took the power you forced upon me and used it to save the innocent. You commanded me to record the end of worlds, but instead, I created a sanctuary.
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: So you think putting on a human mask makes you one of the "Trailblazers." How amusing...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Look at yourselves. That Weathering Curse is still eating away at you and your kin. It is the inescapable price for being a child of Destruction who dares to betray her fate.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: World in Canvas? A total disaster, yet you still try to dress it up as a victory.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Do you know why I haven't spared Ahatopia a single glance for an entire millennium?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Because you bore me.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: But now, things have changed. Someone far more interesting than you has returned. And unlike you, she is the real deal, a genuine Nameless.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: That is why I have returned. Simply to tell you all this.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: Himeko?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I've had my fill of this drama. Now, I'm dying to see how your face handles my fist.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: For a thousand years, I have painted them over and over again. Every innocent life you extinguished during the Cindearth Age...
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: Tell me, Asat Pramad. Are you prepared to face their fury?
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: I have more important things to do than linger here. But this little parting gift of yours...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: I hope I am not too late.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Are you kidding? Your timing is impeccable, Bladie!
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Why not let them have a taste instead?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad

rows.text: But isn't this a bit much? How did you even change outfits? What happened down there?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I used the leviathan's maw to imprison Shuhu. But that doesn't matter.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: What matters is that you made it out alive and got the job done.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Not yet. I have made a decision...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: This time, I will stay and become a Supplicant. I am joining the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: What? You're going to stay here and poke your nose into this world's business too!?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Let us settle this first. Are you okay?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Thank you, all of you.
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: As long as the canvas remains, Asat Pramad cannot kill me. You have fulfilled what Evanescia entrusted to you.
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: It was... all me... For a thousand years, I was the one obsessed with bearing every responsibility alone.
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: Asat Pramad was right after all. I have been a ghost of a thousand years past, arrogant enough to think my seal over the World in Canvas was unbreakable. I really believed that accumulated Wishpower would be enough to strike him down when he returned.
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: We are up against the same nightmare that survived a whole Cindearth Age. The same monster that an entire era could not even overcome.
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: Just how did he even sneak into the World in Canvas?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: The first time I stepped into Inkford Hermitage, a strange wispae tried to latch onto me, but it didn't succeed...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Maybe that was the first step in Asat Pramad's plan to infiltrate this place.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Then, he took on Graphia's form to tamper with my mask and even taught me the way to summon the real Graphia. In the end, he got what he wanted.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: So, this guy has only been after one thing this whole time.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: And to awaken the husk of "the Voracity." We need to leave this place as soon as possible. The giant maw that swallowed me is starting to stir.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: But he mentioned he had something more important to do... What is that even supposed to mean? He has so much on his plate, no way he can split himself into pieces and handle everything at once, right?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: A thousand years ago, the Demon Lord From Beyond invaded Ahatopia. The power he unleashed was beyond all comprehension.
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: He could appear in places thousands of miles apart at the exact same time, as if he possessed countless incarnations.
rows.speaker: Graphia

rows.text: Whaaaaaaaat???
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: He said he was meeting a "genuine Nameless..."
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Himeko, she's in trouble!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The biggest problem... Do you mean me?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: You said that classroom was a secret place of your own creation, yet Fulwish seemed to know everything about it.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You are far too familiar with the Express, yet there is no way my father could have ever set foot on it.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: And another thing, when we first met up earlier, you said it had been fifteen years.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But my father clearly left much earlier than that. Your story is riddled with holes. Or rather, you never even intended to pretend.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You are the only person I can never seem to lie to. And about that last point, it was just a slip of the tongue.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Stop this pathetic act. You are not him.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You, who dare to impersonate my father, show your true self.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It seems our pleasant little father daughter chat has come to an end.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Buying time, keeping me pinned down, you played your part well along the way.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: If I proved to be more dangerous than anticipated, you would be right there to shield your companions.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: But "Navigator," you still overlooked one possibility. The most fatal one of all...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Why don't you try to guess, at what exact point, did I take Ryusuke's place?
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: It happened on the day that man, in his desperate search for the source of the Weathering Curse to save his family, was destroyed by me.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: That year, Himeko was six. At her mother's funeral, she met her father for the first time.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: You are lying.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I have told you only one lie in all these years, my dear daughter.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: "Nice to meet you. I am your father, Ryusuke."
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: All that effort, all those years spent by my side... What are you really planning?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Even I find it hard to tell what goes on in this head of mine sometimes.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: But now as I look at your face, at that exquisite expression, it all makes sense...
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: I had SO MUCH FUN playing a father.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: And the best part? That was not even the most fun I have had today.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Hey! Can you hear me? Someone who looks like Asat Pramad just showed up at the tavern!
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: We are under attack by Asat Pramad! Dan Heng and I will do everything we can to cover Yao Guang...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I have played along this far, so why not make it interesting? Let us add a dash of red to our little opening act.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: You have proven your theory by tearing off the mask of "Ryusuke." As a courtesy, it's now time to strip away your disguise.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: The ugliest lie of the "Trailblaze." The truth that has been hidden for fifteen years.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: "When the Phantasmoon is full again, I will be there as I have promised."
rows.speaker: Red-Haired Woman

rows.text: "I will come back with so many stories to tell you."
rows.speaker: Red-Haired Woman

rows.text: The girl looked up at the stars, but in her heart, she was terrified of setting out. She was afraid of the universe, and even more, she was afraid of the weight of responsibility.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: In the end, she'd left her wishes to someone else. As for her, she chose to lie in a grave and stay in the arcadia forever.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Ryusuke's daughter, Himeko, is long dead. When she saw how vast the stars really were, she ran away.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: Just as the "Trailblaze" will always converge with the "Destruction," culminating in awe-inspiring obliteration.
rows.speaker: Ryusuke

rows.text: "Look at this blade. Fresh from the forge today. I made it."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: ...Looking at it now, it is a crude piece of work.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "I forged this so you can use it to protect yourself."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: In the end, it was I who forged the greatest sin.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "It would be a waste to throw my skills away on the battlefield. You go to the front, and I will forge the divine weapons for you. It is a promise."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: ...By the Reignbow and the Ten Lords. If I betray our bond, let all of existence hunt me down.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: It... it was not meant to be like this.
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: Pity... so much in this world does not go as we wish.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "From now on, if a sword is needed, let it be mine."
rows.speaker: Blade (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: This shell of mine is the only "Blade" there is.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "All that happened... You think you can just walk away from it all?"
rows.speaker: Blade (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: What a pity. In the end... we still cast our weapons aside.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: This is a standard-issue sword I forged for the Cloud Knights, back when I first began my training.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Baiheng... And that bow I forged for her.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Jing Yuan's Devastator Glaive... The weapon I promised to forge for him all those years ago.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: The prosthetic arm and sword-staff for Mr. La Mancha were works created by my master and me.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "This... is not my work?"
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: A weapon given by Yingxing to an old friend...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Apprentice, come here.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: Finally... Is the end in sight?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...Looking at it now, it is a crude piece of work.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: In the end, it was I who forged the greatest sin.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Old friends have drifted across the stars, but he remains.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Old friends have drifted across the stars, but he remains.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: He came to visit me even after I was cast into the Shackling Prison.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "Yingxing, oh Yingxing... How did you end up like this?"
rows.speaker: La Mancha (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: This was where my life as Blade began.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: This was where my life as Blade began.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: But we are no longer who we once were to each other.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: But we are no longer who we once were to each other.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: In the final moments of your life...
What will flicker through your mind?
The devouring... Has it begun?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: How much time has passed?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Sea of Clouds... Ambrosial Arbor...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Huh... To think that with death so close, this is the scenery my dreams would conjure.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: (My heartbeat... It's barely audible now.)
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: (Shuhu... Are you still alive? Am I... Am I still alive?)
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Finally woke up, Yingxing?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: Master...?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...I am sorry. You have the wrong person. I am not Yingxing.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Huh. A lad your age, yet your head is more muddled than mine. You're talking nonsense in your sleep, boy.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: It has been ages since we last met. Tell me, have you let your craft go to waste? Your master wishes to see what you can do.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: Not a sweet dream of toasts and laughter, nor a nightmare of clashing steel...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...Instead, it is a dream of returning to the very beginning, to confess my sins before the master who taught me everything.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Typical...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "Senior frater, are you truly from a short-life species?"
rows.speaker: Hanguang (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Why do you ask?"
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "I mean no offense. I just wondered... Why would you come all the way to the Xianzhou to learn the craft?"
rows.speaker: Hanguang (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "My home became a grazing ground for those borisin beasts. My parents, their fertilizer. Unlike you, I won't live to see them wiped out, but my blades will."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "That is so cool!"
rows.speaker: Hanguang (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Stop flattering me. This is just a standard-issue sword for the Cloud Knights. According to the template, its name should be New Blade: Zero One."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Senior frater! How could you so thoughtlessly name your own creation?"
rows.speaker: Hanguang (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "The very first assignment Elder Huaiyan gave his disciples is 'What defines a blade?' He always says a name carries the weapon's destiny..."
rows.speaker: Hanguang (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "'A lone cloud drifts, a crane departs the woods...'"
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Let's call it 'Departure,' junior frater."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Haha! Senior frater, I thought you'd go with Lone Cloud or Guyun!"
rows.speaker: Hanguang (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "For me? Thank you! I told you, didn't I? As long as you set your heart on what you love, nothing can stop you."
rows.speaker: Baiheng (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Hey, did you give this bow a name?"
rows.speaker: Baiheng (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "I named this bow 'Luer,' after a mythical steed from the Primeval Imperium. Legend says it was one of the Emperor's finest mounts, a divine beast that could tread over any chasm and lead its master back from the brink of death..."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Pfft! How did you get so off track? Why pick a name meant for a horse?"
rows.speaker: Baiheng (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "That won't do! It does not suit me at all. I am going to call it Recurve Bow."
rows.speaker: Baiheng (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "That sounds terrible. It is like my mother naming me 'Human.' At least change it to something elegant, like 'Winding Stream'!"
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Fine. Have it your way."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Look at you, skilled with both the pen and the sword. You really should not be trapped in this Flamewheel Forge for the rest of your life."
rows.speaker: Baiheng (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Hey, perfect timing! I have a few friends getting together on the Luofu. Want to come along?"
rows.speaker: Baiheng (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: Staying in a single place your whole life? That won't do.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "A genius? I suppose Master Jingliu's swordplay should be no trouble for you then."
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Hmph. You little rascal, do not try to act like my senior just yet."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "I am from a short-life species. Xianzhou swordplay takes hundreds, even thousands of years to master. I simply do not have the time."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "I heard your bold claim: 'I'd rather leave this world in a blaze than live until the end of time.' It seems you think little of us Xianzhou people, then?"
rows.speaker: Jingliu (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "My, my, the future Sword Champion has sharp ears. It was just drunken rambling. Don't take it to heart."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Alright, deal! Then I want a devastator glaive, four meters long, decorated with green silk, and you should engrave the blade with cloud patterns, or maybe lightning...?"
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Wait until you have grown a bit taller!"
rows.speaker: Jingliu (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Then it is settled. When the time comes, you shall arm each of us with a weapon of our own. Let us face the fires of war in your place and handle all that tedious business on your behalf."
rows.speaker: Jingliu (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Come, friends, drink up! We five come from all walks of life, but here and now, we are one. Together, we shall bring glory to the Xianzhou and peace to all who dwell beneath the stars..."
rows.speaker: Jingliu (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "The shadow has tasted the flesh of Abundance within you."
rows.speaker: La Mancha (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "You... You cannot even speak anymore."
rows.speaker: La Mancha (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Yingxing, look at me. Lift your head."
rows.speaker: La Mancha (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "It was only thanks to you and your master that the shadow of Voracity was sealed. I owe you both a debt of gratitude."
rows.speaker: La Mancha (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "So, I have but one question: Do you want out? If so, just nod."
rows.speaker: La Mancha (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "There is always a way out. Just give the word, and I will carve a bloody path to get you out right now."
rows.speaker: La Mancha (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "There is... no need."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "I must... atone... for my sins."
rows.speaker: Yingxing (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Perhaps if I had taken you away from Flamewheel Forge back then, your fate would have been entirely different."
rows.speaker: La Mancha (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "I respect your choice, just as I did all those years ago."
rows.speaker: La Mancha (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "So you're Blade? You sound like quite the expert on swords."
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Oh, good timing. What do you make of the sword she's carrying?"
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "The blade itself is fine, but the technique is wrong. Swordsmanship is no song and dance. Power starts at the feet. Only when the eyes and mind follow through will the strike land."
rows.speaker: Blade (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "My oh my, Bladie! You really are the ultimate blade critic!"
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Since you have so much to say, Master, why not forge a legendary blade for each of us?"
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "I put down the hammer a long time ago. My hands cannot do what my mind wants anymore. Fighting with a weapon that does not suit you is just a quicker way to die."
rows.speaker: Blade (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "Who I am? Does not matter."
rows.speaker: Blade (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "What matters is, do you remember this weapon?"
rows.speaker: Blade (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "I don't understand what you're talking about..."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "You would do well to keep Cloud-Piercer by your side, or..."
rows.speaker: Blade (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: "...Next time we meet, I will be the end of you!"
rows.speaker: Blade (In Reminiscence)

rows.text: Poor child. You and the Xianzhou citizens are always so short-sighted.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: Trapped in this waking dream called life, you cling to what is gone and tremble at the thought of being forgotten.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: Yet when I come to carve through your flesh and awaken your minds, you spurn my beautiful gift.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: You were once a master craftsman. You should know best about the beauty of shaping.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: I can grant you the power of reshaping life and death, bringing those you loved and lost back to life. Let your friends return to this world again and again, giving you the chance to right every single wrong.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: Righting wrongs? You mean by carving out more walking husks like me, things that crave an end they can never reach?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: That is but a fleeting pang, a necessary tempering on the path to eternity. If you persist in spurning this gift, then this maw shall become your prison for all time.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: Your body will churn for millennia, caught between being digested and reborn. Every inch of your flesh will remember the agony of being ground to pulp, until your very will dissolves into nothing, leaving only a hollow husk that can cry out my name.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: ...Are you done talking?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Do you truly believe that I am the only prisoner here, Shuhu? You are the one bound most tightly by your chains.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: "For so long as a single soul in this vast world prays for Abundance, I shall return to bestow my grace."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: You are nothing but an echo of THEM, a slave trapped within your mission of "Compassion." You mock our obsessions? You are Yaoshi's most pathetic prisoner.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...Are you trying to provoke me?
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: No. I am pronouncing your sentence. I never dove into this abyss for the sake of "a mutual end."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I came for "forging."
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: As long as you cling to life, you must keep reshaping this body to fight back the gnawing from the Voracity. And that struggle is exactly what I want.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Let the maw of this Aeon husk be the furnace, let our undying flesh be the iron, and let death, a thousand times over, be the hammer...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Right here, I shall forge and recast you, again and again!
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Not to destroy you but to create a cage that can hold you prisoner for all eternity.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: And the thorns of this cage shall forever be aimed at that savior who branded you with your mission, Yaoshi.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Are you ready... to turn your vengeance against your god?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...I see now. So this is how you "forge it anew?"
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: Very well... let us see how this duel between the condemned unfolds, this forging within the furnace—
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: ...In the end, which of us shall forge the other into a "Blade"!
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I am here, Master.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Good. I have waited a long time for you.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: You have seen every blade I have forged in this life.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Fine work. Somewhat flawed, perhaps, but their edge is undeniable. The marks of a true master.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: Gazing upon the weapons I forged in days past, I can only feel a surge of endless regret.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: The hammer falls and cannot be undone, yet I have spent my life taking one wrong step after another.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: I betrayed my friends and broke my oaths. Even with these divine blades, I failed to protect those I held dear. My hands are stained with blood. I loathe the reflection it casts back from my blade.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: But what weighs heaviest on my soul is the debt I owe you, master. In this life, I fear I will never have the chance to repay it.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: ...Let it all out. You feel a bit lighter now, don't you?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: But isn't there one last piece you've yet to show me?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: It has yet to be named, has it not?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: That is a mere scrap from the forging of Shard Sword. I hid it away, fearing it would bring shame upon our school. Master, how did you...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Can a mere boy keep secrets from his master? I entrusted General Yao Guang to bring it to you.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: Since the day you left, I have kept this blade hung in the hall, gazing upon it daily. That raw, youthful spirit within it, it burns to the touch.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: It is the same light that shone in your eyes the day you bowed to me. It is the keen edge of a craftsman.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: I am but rusted scrap now, my light has long since faded. This is where I belong, buried.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: Crushed ore, old materials, rusted iron... As craftsmen, we spend our entire lives in such company.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: "Waste not the bounty of the world, but perfect it through craft." To take what is useless, to take every failed scrap and forge it anew, isn't that our very mission as craftsmen?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: Even for a life that has reached its end, a life built on nothing but mistakes?
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: As it is with the work of a craftsman, so it must be with the life of a craftsman.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: Do you still remember the question I once asked you: What defines a blade?
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: The answer already lies within you. Go now, and forge {RUBY_B#you}it{RUBY_E#} anew.
rows.speaker: Huaiyan (In Dreams)

rows.text: "Forge it anew." Interesting.
rows.speaker: Yingxing (?)

rows.text: "Now I wish more than anything that I could just live a bit longer." Yingxing himself said that, back when he was nearing his end.
rows.speaker: Yingxing (?)

rows.text: Shuhu...
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: You've fought me all this time and leapt into the leviathan's maw, nothing more than a bid to drag me down with you.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: A pity, truly. For so long as a single soul in this vast world prays for Abundance, I shall return to bestow my grace.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: And now, I have come in answer to your prayer. Within the leviathan's maw, I shall grant you a thousand years of agony as your flesh will be remade only to be devoured again and again. You shall find no release.
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: Is this not exactly what you call "Forge it anew"?
rows.speaker: Shuhu

rows.text: We have arrived. This is the snowy shore of the canvas world, Inkford Hermitage.
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: Are those wispae floating on the water?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Mighty! Wishpower! Mighty! Superstar!
rows.speaker: Wispae

rows.text: Oh dear, there are so many wispae. They are blocking the boat's route.
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: But no need to panic. Please follow my lead.
rows.speaker: Agent Feld

rows.text: Being mobbed by fans is just part of a hero's destiny!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Come on, let's catch up with [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: Feld
